name: rust-crate-fqn-stability
body: The Rust frontend fix must be FQN-stable for every package that scans today: it may change rendered module/symbol FQNs only for packages whose crates currently collide (multi-target packages with duplicate target display names), which today make `apg scan` panic and therefore have no existing FQN to preserve. A package with a single local crate target, a lib-only package, and a bin-only package must keep exactly the module FQNs they render today. This is the change-set's reading of `global.constraint.checkout-independent-graph-identity` and the parent-cannot-depend-on-the-child rule: the plan and spec use the running binary's vocabulary, so the fix may not rename any currently-resolvable FQN.
